description: Save translations you wrote yourself, so neither a catalog nor the state file is ever edited by hand. Each one is checked the way verbaly_translate checks a provider (params, rich tags and plural cases must survive), written only for keys the source catalog has, and marked as a draft awaiting human review. Existing translations are kept unless overwrite is set, which is how an outdated one gets rewritten. Approving is not a tool here: a human reads the drafts (verbaly_drafts lists them) and runs `verbaly review --approve`.

locale.description: Target locale, one of the project's non-source locales

overwrite.description: Replace translations that already exist, for example outdated ones

root.description: Project root holding verbaly.config (defaults to the server working directory)

name: verbaly_write_drafts

invalid.description: Rejected: empty, or the params, tags or plural cases were not preserved

kept.description: Already translated, left as they were (overwrite replaces them)

unknown.description: Not in the source catalog, so nothing was written

written.description: Saved as drafts, a human still has to approve them

title: Save translations an agent wrote
